charts.name: Revenue and Bookings Chart
charts.formula: Captured collections = sum unique successful capture ledger event amounts in financial event range; refunds = sum unique successful refund event amounts in refund event range; net collections = captures - refunds. Recognized revenue is separate, only from finance-approved recognition entries/policy and never inferred from cash. Booking count = distinct booking IDs confirmedAt in bucket (not sessions scheduled today).
charts.contract: financialBuckets + bookingBuckets (combo only), with separate capture/refund event basis and confirmedAt count; recognitionBuckets separate optional contract.
charts.axes: X local bucket label; left money/currency; right integer booking count. Both start at zero; signed financial axis may extend below zero.
charts.tooltip: Exact bucket/timezone, captured collections, successful refunds, net collections, currency/date basis/completeness; confirmedAt bookings on combo. Recognized revenue only if approved recognition data explicitly selected.
charts.legend: Net collections; confirmed bookings (combo only); explicit selected basis. Recognized revenue never an alias of net collections.
charts.responsive: Full width; minimum 240px plot; reduce ticks, stack legend; dual-axis labels retained, table available.
charts.population: Authorized venue/room dataset; finance ledger events, booking cohort or room/device snapshot as specified in formula; no client-page-only aggregates.
charts.units: LKR minor units with ISO currency and integer counts (separate scales)
charts.timeBasis: UTC instants; explicit Asia/Colombo [from,to) local reporting boundaries; named financial event / confirmedAt / createdAt / scheduled service / snapshot basis as formula states.
charts.authorizedDataSource: Backend-authorized module read projections under analytics.read, room/device.read or payments.read where applicable; proposed contract, no actual endpoint verified.
charts.freshness: Response asOf/complete/warnings plus observedAt for snapshots; per-service refresh/stale threshold policy TBD, stale values labelled and retained.

charts.name: Room Status Donut Chart
charts.formula: Population = all enabled rooms in authorized selected venue/room scope at snapshotAt, each exactly once in occupied/available/cleaning/maintenance/unknown. Donut center = booking-based occupied count / sum all five slice counts × 100. Zero rooms → N/A. Unknown stays in population and is labelled; center is not physical occupancy. Slice percent and center share scope/asOf/denominator. Proposed state projection uses policy-versioned precedence maintenance > unknown/stale readiness > cleaning_required/cleaning > occupied by noncancelled confirmed session covering snapshotAt > available with physical clearance and no active session. Conflicting booking/readiness facts also raise an incident; state is not proof of physical presence.
charts.contract: roomSnapshot with mutually exclusive states, stateObservedAt and snapshotAt; explicit unknown/stale handling.
charts.axes: No axes; center label booking-based occupied / all scoped rooms and denominator. Physical occupancy unknown unless separate validated observation contract.
charts.tooltip: State, count, percentage of all scoped status rooms, observedAt and freshness. Unknown is not unoccupied.
charts.legend: All five states with counts; occupied violet, available green, cleaning amber, maintenance red, unknown gray.
